title: UX/UI-designer
description:
Vill du vara med och skapa digitala upplevelser som gör skillnad – både för användarna och samhället? Hos Tre får du kombinera kreativitet och användarinsikter med teknik och data för att forma lösningar som förenklar vardagen för hundratusentals människor. Här arbetar vi i en miljö där innovation, samarbete och samhällsnytta går hand i hand.
   

  

**Om rollen**
 Som UX/UI Designer hos Tre blir du en del av vårt Growth & Experience-team inom Online Consumer Market. Här får du möjlighet att utveckla några av våra mest centrala digitala produkter.
   

  

 I rollen dyker du ner i användarnas behov genom intervjuer, observationer och analys av data, och omsätter insikterna till flöden, wireframes och prototyper som är både intuitiva och affärsmässiga. Du planerar och leder tester, analyserar resultat och itererar tills lösningarna sitter.
   

  

 I vardagen samarbetar du tätt med produktägare, utvecklare, CRO-specialister och webbanalytiker, och tillsammans med våra UX-designers i Sverige och Danmark hittar du lösningar som fungerar på båda marknaderna och möter olika användarbehov. Du bidrar även till utvecklingen av våra designprinciper och komponentbibliotek, med fokus på tillgänglighet, enhetlighet och skalbarhet. Här får du både kreativ frihet och strategiskt ansvar – och chansen att påverka hur våra digitala produkter upplevs av användarna.
   

  

**Du kan se fram emot att**
* driva kreativa initiativ och testa nya idéer i en datadriven miljö
* bidra till att våra digitala tjänster blir mer inkluderande och tillgängliga för alla användare
* vara med och påverka hur vi bygger framtidens digitala kundupplevelse hos Tre
* vara en del av Sveriges bästa arbetsplatser enligt Great Place To Work samt att vi är stolt samarbetspartner till Women in Tech och Tjejer Kodar.


 ,
   

  

**Vem är du?**
 Vi söker dig som har flera års erfarenhet av UX/UI-design inom digital produktutveckling, gärna från telekombranschen eller andra komplexa och tekniskt avancerade verksamheter, och som trivs i en miljö där data, hypoteser och användarinsikter styr riktningen. Du har vana av att arbeta med både app och webb, och du använder Figma som ditt främsta verktyg. Du har god förståelse för tillgänglighetslagstiftningen och designar med inkluderande användarupplevelser i fokus.
   

  

 Som person är du nyfiken, samarbetsorienterad och självgående. Du har förmågan att förklara och visualisera idéer på ett tydligt och engagerande sätt, oavsett om du pratar med utvecklare, produktägare eller andra designers. För att lyckas i rollen behöver du kunna kommunicera obehindrat på både svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift, och förklarar dina idéer tydligt till olika målgrupper. Du trivs i en miljö där förändring är vardag och ser möjligheter i att samarbeta över team och marknader. Om du dessutom har erfarenhet av att arbeta med designsystem och samarbeten i internationella team ser vi det som ett plus.
   

  

**Din ansökan**
 Vi tar emot ansökningar via denna annons och kommer hålla intervjuer löpande. Personligt brev behövs inte, men vi vill gärna att du bifogar CV och svarar på de frågor vi ställt nedan i samband med att du söker. Vi använder tester för att säkra objektiva bedömningar i samband med urval. Tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag. Bakgrundskontroll görs på slutkandidat
   

  

**Välkommen till Tre!**

title: Senior UX Designer | Candy Crush Saga
description:
**Craft:**
 UX & UI
   

  

**Job Description:**
 At King, we put players at the heart of everything we do. We’re looking for a passionate Senior UX Designer who thrives on crafting fun, engaging, and meaningful experiences for millions of players around the world. You’ll work closely with a cross-functional team to bring new ideas to life, evolve existing systems, and ensure every design decision balances player delight with business goals. If you’re excited by the challenge of designing for a global audience and shaping the future of free-to-play mobile games, this is the role for you.
   

  

 Your role within our Kingdom
   

  

 As a Senior UX Designer in Player Value, you'll shape experiences that strengthen motivation, progression, and long-term engagement across Candy Crush Saga.
   

  

 This role suits someone who brings clarity to ambiguity, connects player needs with product and business goals, and drives strong design direction across complex systems, working closely with Product, Game Design, UI, Art, Data, Engineering, and Leadership to frame opportunities, shape solutions, and deliver player value at scale.
   

  

 You'll help define how players understand, feel, and act on the value of playing, across progression, rewards, streaks, challenge loops and post-level experiences; the systems that keep players coming back.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Own UX strategy for Player Value across progression, rewards, streaks, challenges, onboarding, and engagement systems
* Lead discovery and problem framing for complex player-facing initiatives, turning insights and constraints into clear direction
* Design end-to-end experiences, from flows and prototypes to specs and content, owning quality through delivery
* Partner across Product, Game Design, UI, Art, Data, and Engineering, bridging crafts and seniority levels to align teams on feasibility and design quality
* Ground decisions in evidence, working with UX Research and Data to iterate and improve over time
* Advocate for the player experience and long-term design quality


**Skills**
* Extensive senior experience in UX design within the casual gaming industry, with strong systems thinking and a rigorous design methodology
* Skilled at balancing player needs, design craft, and product goals to create genuinely impactful experiences
* Strong sense of ownership and autonomy, with the confidence to drive work forward independently
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and facilitation skills that help align teams around a shared vision
* Grounded in data and insights, using them to inform and validate design decisions


**About King**
 With a mission of
 *Making the World Playful* 
 , King is a leading interactive entertainment company for the mobile world with more than 20 years of history of delivering some of the world’s most iconic games in the mobile gaming industry, including the world-famous Candy Crush franchise, as well as other mobile titles such as
 *Farm Heroes Saga* 
 . King games are played by more than 200 million monthly active users. King, part of Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT), has Kingsters in Stockholm, Malmö, London, Barcelona, Berlin, Dublin, San Francisco, New York, Los Angeles and Malta. More information can be found at King.com or by following us on LinkedIn and @lifeatking on Instagram.

title: Senior UX/UI Designer
description:
Why Valtech? We’re the experience innovation company - a trusted partner to the world’s most recognized brands. To our people we offer growth opportunities, a values-driven culture, international careers and the chance to shape the future of experience.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 At Valtech, you’ll find an environment designed for continuous learning, meaningful impact, and professional growth. Whether you're pioneering new digital solutions, challenging conventional thinking or building the next generation of customer experiences, your work will help transform industries.
   

  

**We Are Proud Of**
* The work we do and the innovation we drive
* Our values of share, care and dare
* A workplace culture that fosters creativity, diversity and autonomy
* Our borderless, global framework, which enables seamless collaboration


**The role**
 Do you want to design digital experiences that truly make a difference – for users, clients, and society?
   

  

 Valtech Sweden is looking for a
 **Senior** 
**UX/UI Designer** 
 who thrives at the intersection of design, technology, and business – and who brings practical experience working with AI in digital products. At Valtech, we combine design, technology, and business to create experiences that truly matter. You will be part of a strong, collaborative community and work on projects where quality, innovation, and user value are at the core.
   

  

 As a
 **UX/UI Designer** 
 you will work closely with clients and cross-functional teams to create user-centric, scalable, and business-driven digital solutions.
   

  

 You will work across both UX and UI, moving seamlessly from insight and structure to high-quality, implementation-ready design.
   

  

**Role Responsibilities**
* Drive UX and UI work from concept to final delivery
* Create user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and polished interfaces
* Own and evolve design systems to ensure consistency and scalability
* Design user experiences where AI is a meaningful and integrated component
* Ensure clarity, usability, and trust in AI-related interactions and flows
* Collaborate closely with Product Owners and client stakeholders
* Work with developers in agile teams to ensure designs are implementation-ready
* Facilitate and contribute to workshops with clients and internal teams


**We believe you have** 
  

  

* 7+ years of experience working across both UX and UI
* Hands-on experience working with AI in digital products, for example:
+ Designing AI-supported features or user flows
+ Working in projects where AI is part of the end-user experience
+ Using AI tools in a structured and repeatable way in your design process

* Strong experience working with design systems in scalable environments
* Excellent ability to translate concepts into concrete, high-quality interfaces
* Experience working closely with developers and understanding technical constraints
* Strong ability to structure and clarify requirements end-to-end
* A pragmatic, confident, and collaborative mindset
* Solid experience with Figma or similar tools
* Experience working with accessibility standards (WCAG)


**Language**
* You are fluent in Swedish


**Nice To Have Qualifications**
* Experience conducting user testing in fast-paced environments
* Data-driven design experience
* Experience with complex flows (e.g. e-commerce, booking)


**If you do not meet all the listed qualifications or have gaps in your experience, we still encourage you to apply. At Valtech, we recognize that talent comes in many forms, and we value diverse perspectives and a willingness to learn.**
**We Offer**
* Exciting assignments with leading brands
* A high degree of freedom with responsibility
* Opportunities to influence both your own development and our solutions
* A flexible hybrid work environment
* A centrally located Stockholm office
* Daily breakfast and fika


**Commitment to reaching all kinds of people**
 We design experiences that work for all kinds of people - and that starts with our own teams. At Valtech, we’re intentional about building an inclusive culture where everyone feels supported to grow, thrive and achieve their goals. No matter your background, you belong here. Explore our Diversity & Inclusion site to see how we’re creating a more equitable Valtech for all.
   

  

**The Benefits**
 This is a
 **full-time** 
 job position based in
 **Stockholm,** 
 with a
 **hybrid working model** 
 (at least 2-3 days work from our Stockholm office).
   

  

**Beyond a Competitive Compensation Package, We Offer**
* Flexibility, with remote and hybrid work options (country-dependent)
* Career advancement, with international mobility and professional development programs
* Learning and development, with access to cutting-edge tools, training and industry experts


 Our benefits are tailored to each location. Your Talent Partner will provide full details during the hiring process.
   

  

**Your application process**
 Once you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application. Your CV should cover key information on relevant experiences and expertise. We do not require information such as age, gender, marital status, or a headshot in your application. We review all candidates based on skills, experience, and potential.
   

  

 ⚠️ Beware of recruitment fraud!
   

  

 We are committed to inclusion and accessibility. If you need reasonable accommodations during the interview process, please either indicate it in your application or let your Talent Partner know.
   

  

**About Valtech**
 Valtech is the experience innovation company that exists to unlock a better way to experience the world. By blending crafts, categories, and cultures, we help brands unlock new value in an increasingly digital world.
   

  

 At the intersection of data, AI, creativity, and technology, we drive transformation for leading organizations, including L’Oréal, Mars, Audi, P&G, Volkswagen Dolby, and more.
   

  

 At Valtech, we don’t just talk about transformation. We make it happen. Our people are the heart of our success, and we foster a workplace where everyone has the support to thrive, grow and innovate.
   

  

 Are you ready to create what’s next? Join us.

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
**Your work days are brighter here.**
 We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Sana is Workday’s AI lab building superintelligence for work. We believe organizations can accomplish their missions faster when teams can effortlessly access knowledge, automate repetitive work, and learn anything with the help of agentic AI. As part of Workday, we are committed to building responsible AI that augments people - not replaces them.
   

  

 We’re a talent-dense, product-obsessed team of engineers and designers united by a love for design excellence and rapid iteration.
   

  

**About The Role**
 You will be part of driving the design of the next generation of agentic-first experiences. Defining how humans interact with autonomous AI that plans, reasons, and executes complex tasks across enterprise environments. You will collaborate with a small team of product designers and cross-discipline partners to define and build the experiences of tomorrow.
   

  

 This role is based in our Stockholm office.
   

  

****In this role, you will****
* Contribute to the overall design and vision for our products.
* Design and ship high-quality products and features to 75M+ users, from early prototypes to final product (we welcome designers to ship production work).
* Help drive short term bets and contribute to long term strategy.
* Partner with Product and Engineering to balance technical constraints—like non-determinism and latency—with delightful, high-quality user experiences.
* Contribute to our design system and help scale great design across a team of 200+ contributors.
* Influence senior leadership and stakeholders by storytelling a clear vision for the future of AI-native work.


**About You**
**Basic Qualification**
* 5+ years of experience as a Product Designer
* A proven track record of executing complex design projects
* Contributing to large-scale products, or have owned smaller products outright.
* A portfolio that showcases your expertise in designing experiences with a high bar for quality and craft.


**Other Qualification**
* A love for thinking through complex problems and turning them into great experiences
* You get excited about the future and want to help shape how it gets experienced


**Workday Pay Transparency Statement (For EU Locations Only)**
 Listed below is the base salary range applicable to this position. Workday pay ranges (and the precise pay offered to the successful candidate) are based on a number of objective criteria such as relevant experience and skills, and educational qualifications, level of responsibility, demands of the role, work location and business need. As a part of the total compensation package, this role may be eligible for the Workday Bonus Plan or a role-specific commission/bonus, as well as annual refresh stock grants awarded by Workday Inc. For more information regarding Workday’s comprehensive benefits, please click here.
   

  

 Primary Location Base Pay Range: kr756,000 SEK - kr1,133,000 SEK Sweden
   

  

**Our Approach to Flexible Work**
 With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in-office each week, we simply
 **spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field** 
 with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter.
   

  

 Pursuant to applicable Fair Chance law, Workday will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.
   

  

 Workday is an Equal Opportunity Employer including individuals with disabilities and protected veterans.

title: Design Director
description:
Mentimeter is an engagement tool with a clear goal in mind. To turn presentations into conversations. Through real-time interactivity and clear visualizations, we get people to participate, engage and become more productive. Transforming all those passive meetings, airless classrooms and drawn out trainings into valuable and memorable moments.
   

  

 We truly believe that you achieve the best results by doing things together. And that successful leaders need to adopt a curious and collaborative mindset in order to get there. So with you at Mentimeter, you’ll be a big part of the ambition to help over 1 billion people listen, learn and work better together.
   

  

**The Role**
 As Design Director for our Engagement Tools, you will own parts of the core experience that hundreds of millions of people rely on to turn passive audiences into active participants. This is a role for a design leader who sets direction by shaping the work, not only by managing it.
   

  

 You will join a product company at a pivotal moment. As Mentimeter evolves from a single tool into an integrated Engagement Suite, the hardest and most valuable design problems now live at the seams, where journeys span areas and coherence is a competitive advantage. You will operate in two primary contexts: within your Product Area Leadership, where the work happens alongside the Product Director and Engineering Director, and within the Design Leadership Team, partnering the Chief Design Officer and fellow Design leaders. You will define the experience direction for your areas and make sure design decisions translate into measurable customer and business impact.
   

  

 You will report to the Chief Design Officer.
   

  

**What We Are Looking For**
 We are looking for a design leader who leads through the work. Someone with the judgment to set a clear experience direction and the hands-on capability to raise the quality bar by shaping, critiquing, and making alongside the team.
   

  

 You have led designers in fast-moving, product-led environments, and you have earned your credibility through the impact and quality of your work. You are as comfortable owning experience strategy for a product area as you are getting into the detail of a flow that isn't good enough yet. You operate as a true peer to product and engineering leaders, and you believe design is at its best when it drives outcomes, not when it decorates them.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Set the experience direction: Define a clear experience vision and architecture for your product areas, and hold the quality bar that makes it real.
* Shape what doesn't exist yet: Lead the design of new AI powered products, navigating the ambiguity and complexity of finding product-market fit where there is no established path to follow.
* Drive product impact through design: Own the link between design decisions and the metrics that matter, including activation, engagement, retention, and expansion.
* Lead as a peer in the area: Work alongside the Product Director and Engineering Director to shape area strategy and roadmap, driving user and experience thinking into the decisions that set direction.
* Own coherence across the Engagement Suite: Take responsibility for experience quality at the boundaries with adjacent areas, so journeys that span the product feel like one product.
* Develop the craft and the team: Recruit, coach, and grow Product Designers primarily through the work itself, calibrating performance honestly and having the direct conversations that help people grow.
* Raise the bar with your peers: Work with fellow design leaders to hold shared experience principles and a shared quality standard across the craft, giving and taking critique at leadership level.
* Evolve practice through AI: Push how design understands, explores, prototypes, and delivers with AI, increasing speed and quality while protecting product thinking and craft.


**Requirements**
* 8+ years in design, including mid-to-senior management experience leading designers in fast-moving, product-led organisations.
* Proven track record of creating impactful product outcomes through design leadership and delivery.
* High personal design capability, with a portfolio that demonstrates craft judgment and range.
* A player-coach leadership style: credible with senior designers, and effective at developing them through the work.
* Track record of setting experience direction and connecting design decisions to measurable product outcomes.
* Strong business acumen and the ability to hold your own as a peer to product and engineering leadership.
* Exceptional communication skills, able to align teams and stakeholders around a clear direction.
* Practical experience applying AI to design exploration, prototyping, and delivery.


**Not Required**
 You don’t have to know Swedish. Daily work is carried out in English and the Mentimeter team currently boasts over 50 nationalities!
   

  

**Compensation**
*At Mentimeter, we believe in fair and transparent compensation that grows with you.*
*The salary range for this role is SEK88,000 - SEK102,000 per month. It’s intentionally broad to reflect the different stages of growth within the role. Where an individual is placed within the range depends on factors such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, and alignment with the role’s requirements.*
*We’re committed to supporting your growth. You’ll have ongoing development conversations with your manager and build skills, contribute to our mission and have meaningful impact.*
*In addition to your monthly salary, we offer a comprehensive benefits package - learn more about it here: https://www.mentimeter.com/benefits/stockholm*
**What Mentimeter Can Offer**
 At Mentimeter we can offer a diverse and inclusive work environment supported by smart and driven colleagues. We believe in continuous professional development for all of our colleagues and therefore offer access to a leadership program (including external personal coach) and relevant education to ensure that we continue to be state-of-the-art when it comes to innovating and building Mentimeter. Your place will be in a growing company with lots of career opportunities, working on a beloved product used by more than 300 million people. It’s not all about work though, we also offer a very healthy view on work-life balance.
   

  

 All of this comes attached with a competitive compensation and benefits package, including pension contributions. Learn more about our benefits by visiting our Benefits & Perks page
   

  

**AI and Hiring at Mentimeter**
 At Mentimeter, we believe AI helps us work smarter - but it never replaces the human assessment, curiosity, and personal connection that define our culture and our hiring. We use AI as a sparring partner: to bounce ideas, bring new perspectives, support structure, and make our work more efficient. But the meaning, decisions, and interactions always come from people.
   

  

* AI does not screen or decide on candidates.
* There is no automated filtering, ranking, or decision-making in our recruitment process. Every application is reviewed by a person.
* Hiring teams may use AI to support their work - for example, to structure notes, prepare interview questions, or organize their thinking.


 AI strengthens our work, but it does not define it. At Mentimeter, we’re not building an AI-driven hiring process - we’re building a people-first culture, where technology helps us listen, learn, and grow together.
   

  

**Culture at Mentimeter**
 At Mentimeter we believe in giving everyone a voice - regardless of who you are. So we build a platform that does just that. Our platform is not only our product but also our organization. A platform where people feel safe, where differences are embraced, a place where you can have fun. We strongly encourage applicants who are people of color, LGBTQ+, women, people with disabilities, and/or formerly incarcerated people, and a college degree is not strictly required. In order to give everyone a voice, we need to be as diverse as our users.
   

  

 Learn more about our culture by visiting our Culture page.
   

  

 Review our Privacy Policy for more information.

title: Product Designer L1 (Consumer Facing / Marketing) (Bangkok - Based)
description:
**About Agoda**
 At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.
   

  

 Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.
   

  

 No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.
   

  

**Our Purpose – Bridging the World Through Travel**
 We believe travel allows people to enjoy, learn and experience more of the amazing world we live in. It brings individuals and cultures closer together, fostering empathy, understanding and happiness.
   

  

 We are a skillful, driven and diverse team from across the globe, united by a passion to make an impact. Harnessing our innovative technologies and strong partnerships, we aim to make travel easy and rewarding for everyone.
   

  

 We believe in making it easier for everyone to experience the world.
   

  

**Getting to know our Agoda Design Team**
 Embark on a journey with the Agoda Design Team, a vibrant community of product designers crafting innovative solutions from the heart of Bangkok, Thailand. As a pivotal force in our product-driven company, we collaborate closely with product managers and engineers to unravel customer challenges, shaping workflows, interactions, and visual interfaces. Whether you’re honing your craft, expanding your skillset, or stepping into a leadership role, now is the time to join a team that’s both scrappy and hands-on yet influential enough to drive change and shape product strategy. Be a part of Agoda’s Design team and contribute to unlocking the world for our global community of travelers.
   

  

**Product Designers at Agoda are responsible for:**
 Designing products for Agoda involves understanding and integrating diverse consumer needs, behaviors, and expectations across different regions. Products should be crafted to deliver exceptional quality and usability that resonate universally. It is essential to prioritize intuitive design, seamless functionality, and accessibility, while also addressing factors such as user behavior and data insights. As part of the platform team you will be central in improving our customer experience across the business.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Running discovery phases and helping define product requirements
* Testing prototypes and hypotheses with users to collect feedback
* Present your work to peers and leadership, async and in-person
* Take part in weekly design critiques, workshops, all hands, and squad meetings
* Think and write about your process and detailing your decisions
* Champion cohesion and consistency in UX design that unites a growing family of products/features
* Be a strategic leader with a vision in how to implement experiences that represent the most customer-centric intersection between design, business, content, and technology.


**Product Designer at Agoda means you have a track record of**
* At least 3 years of experience as a Product Designer, with a strong portfolio showcasing your expertise in user-centered design.
* You work alongside your design partners in driving discovery and ideation workshops and align the group around a vision and approach
* You have a track record of crafting sophisticated flows and customer journeys
* You can think and craft at a system level, not just interface elements or pages
* You’ll regularly make use of your soft skills: listening, negotiating, decision-making
* You can balance multiple priorities and successfully deliver in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.


**Qualities we value in designers**
* Effective articulation of ideas and design solutions
* Expressing feedback with kindness and candor
* Tolerance for ambiguity and healthy curiosity
* Translation of quantitative & qualitative insights into design decisions
* Contribution to our culture: motivation, optimism, quality, integrity


**Nice to haves**
* Previous experience working for an Online Travel Agency


**Qualities we value in :**
* A master of the craft and cohesive product strategy leader who is a person with endless curiosity
* Effective articulation of ideas and design solutions
* Expressing feedback with kindness and candor
* Tolerance for ambiguity and healthy curiosity
* Translation of quantitative & qualitative insights into design decisions
* Contribution to our culture: motivation, optimism, quality, integrity
* Prior experience designing for consumer-facing products
* Visual design skills


 Join us in shaping the future of travel experiences at Agoda!

title: M365 User Adoption Specialist
description:
Som M365 User Adoption Specialist arbetar du nära verksamheten med att säkerställa att vi får ut maximal nytta av vår M365-plattform. Du är en nyckelperson i arbetet med att skapa nytta, där fokus ligger på att utveckla arbetssätt, öka användning och stötta medarbetare i det dagliga arbetet.
 



  





 I rollen driver du införande och användning (user adoption) och nyttorealisering inom M365 genom att planera och genomföra workshops, utbildningar och teamövningar. Du stöttar verksamheten i hur de använder verktyg som Teams, SharePoint och Copilot på bästa sätt och fungerar som en rådgivande part kring moderna arbetssätt och samarbete. Du ansvarar även för att driva och utveckla forum kopplade till M365 och Copilot, följa upp användning samt bidra till kontinuerlig utveckling. En viktig del av rollen är att hålla dig uppdaterad kring nya funktioner och möjligheter i plattformen, samt att fungera som en brygga mellan IT och verksamheten. Du arbetar nära flera funktioner såsom verksamhet, ledningsgrupper, ambassadörer, HR, kommunikation, supportorganisation samt IT och externa leverantörer.
 



  





**För att passa i rollen ser vi att du har:** 



* Erfarenhet av att arbeta med M365 (Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Copilot)
* Erfarenhet av user adoption, förändringsledning eller införande av digitala arbetssätt
* Erfarenhet av att hålla workshops, utbildningar eller liknande aktiviteter
* Erfarenhet av verksamhetsnära arbete och förmåga att omsätta behov till konkreta arbetssätt och rekommendationer
* God kommunikativ förmåga och vana att anpassa budskap till olika målgrupper, från ledning till slutanvändare
* Grundläggande förståelse för informationssäkerhet, GDPR och säkert användande av digitala verktyg



  





 Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet från offentlig sektor eller större organisationer, där du har arbetat i komplexa miljöer med många intressenter. Har du arbetat strukturerat med förändringsledning, exempelvis enligt Prosci eller liknande metodik, ser vi det som ett plus.
 



  





 Vi ser också gärna att du har kommit i kontakt med etablerade arbetssätt och metoder kopplade till digital utveckling, till exempel erfarenhet av att arbeta med utbildningsportaler eller e-learning (som Learnifier eller motsvarande), eller att du har använt projektmetodik såsom XLPM eller liknande ramverk i ditt arbete.
 



  





 Vidare är det positivt om du har en generell förståelse för närliggande områden inom M365-ekosystemet, såsom Power Platform, Copilot, automatisering eller AI-relaterade arbetssätt – inte för att utveckla lösningar själv, utan för att kunna förstå möjligheter och föra dialog med verksamheten.
 



  





 För att trivas och lyckas i rollen ser vi att du är pedagogisk och kommunikativ med god förmåga att anpassa budskap till olika målgrupper. Du är relationsskapande och trivs i en roll med många kontaktytor, samtidigt som du är drivande och tar initiativ för att få saker att hända. Vidare är du nyfiken och håller dig uppdaterad inom området samt har ett serviceinriktat förhållningssätt där du motiveras av att stötta andra och skapa värde i verksamheten.
 



  





 Telgekoncernen och Södertälje kommun har en omfattande IT-miljö med ca 8 000 användare. Detta ställer stora krav på oss som organisation och är en viktig del av vår digitalisering. Du samarbetar med kollegor från alla hörn av vår stora organisation.

title: PRODUCT MANAGER BOOKING & PAYMENTS
description:
**Product Manager Booking & Payments**
 SAS is looking for a commercially driven Product Manager to own and evolve a key stage of the digital customer journey across web and app. Sitting in the Digital Sales team within E-Commerce, this role is accountable for the product strategy, roadmap, and revenue outcomes - for the booking and payments stage of the customer journey. The role is working in close collaboration with Digital & IT delivery teams and commercial stakeholders.
   

  

 The PM is the commercial owner of their domain. They define what gets built and why, set the success metrics, and are accountable for the product strategy, roadmap, and revenue outcomes, contributing to making Digital Sales a core growth engine for SAS.
   

  

**Challenges You Will Work On**
* Own and drive product performance: Accountable for conversion, revenue, and customer experience within your journey stage, proactively identifying and driving opportunities to improve performance and unlock growth
* Define product strategy and priorities: Translate business goals, customer insights, benchmarking, and data analysis into a clear product vision and roadmap, incorporating innovation and emerging technologies (including AI) where they drive measurable value.
* Drive discovery and experimentation: Lead structured discovery and hypothesis-driven development, using data, customer insights, and benchmarking to validate opportunities and solutions through experimentation, including testing new concepts and AI-enabled capabilities
* Translate strategy into execution: Work closely with Product Owners and delivery teams to ensure priorities are clearly defined, well-prepared, and executed with high quality and speed
* Manage trade-offs and stakeholder alignment: Operate in a complex environment, making transparent prioritization decisions and aligning stakeholders around value-driven outcomes
* Measure impact and close the loop: Define success metrics, track performance, and ensure delivered initiatives translate into measurable business value.


**The Team**
 You will work as part of a cross-functional product environment together with Product Owners, designers, engineers, architects, and business stakeholders. The setup is highly collaborative and distributed across Commercial and Digital & IT, requiring strong communication, trust, and shared ownership of outcomes. You will report to Head of Digital Sales.
   

  

 The team culture emphasizes customer-centricity, learning, empowerment, and continuous improvement. Product Managers are expected to act as internal voices of the customer while enabling teams to deliver value effectively and sustainably.
   

  

**To be successful we believe you have**
* 5+ years of experience as a Product Manager, with end-to-end ownership across the product lifecycle from discovery and definition to delivery and value realization
* Experience working with checkout and payment flows, including understanding of payment methods, transaction funnels, and factors impacting conversion and payment success rates
* Srong commercial and product acumen, with proven ability to translate business strategy, customer insights, and data into clear product vision, priorities, and roadmaps
* Experience driving product performance, with a solid understanding of key digital KPIs (e.g. conversion, revenue, funnel performance) and how to improve them
* Hands-on experience with product discovery and experimentation, including defining problem statements, hypotheses, success metrics, and validating solutions through data and testing
* Strong prioritization and decision-making skills, balancing customer value, business impact, and technical considerations in complex stakeholder environments
* Experience working in agile product development setups, collaborating effectively with Product Owners, engineering teams, UX/design, and architecture
* Strong analytical and data-driven mindset, with hands-on experience using GA4 (or similar) to analyze funnels, identify opportunities, and drive product decisions
* Ability to operate in a matrix organization, partnering across Commercial and Digital & IT, and navigating dependencies related to architecture, security, and compliance
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to align diverse audiences around product direction and priorities
* Customer-centric and curious mindset, with a focus on challenging assumptions, innovation, and continuous improvement
* Fluency in English; Scandinavian language is a plus
* Experience in digital travel or product-led digital businesses is a strong advantage


**Why SAS?**
 At SAS, we offer extensive opportunities for professional development in an international, fast-paced working environment. We are dedicated to the continuous growth of our employees. Working with us comes with a variety of benefits, including:
   

  

* Travel Perks: Enjoy discounted travel opportunities around the world with SAS.
* Health & Wellness: Access to health and wellness benefits, including a newly renovated gym with complimentary classes such as CrossFit and yoga.
* Discounts: Receive discounts from a wide range of brands, as well as on transportation to and from airports, airport shops, hotels, and car rentals.
* Work Environment: Our office location in Frösundavik offers a vibrant workspace with a restaurant, café, and easy access to outdoor activities in Hagaparken and Brunnsviken. Engage in running, tennis, outdoor gym sessions, kayaking, and stand-up paddling with equipment available free of charge.
* Convenient Commute: Benefit from a non-stop bus service connecting our office to Solna station, and commuter trains, alongside a network of cycle paths.


**Our Culture at SAS**
 At SAS, we are dedicated to caring for each other, delighting our travelers, and driving the transformation towards sustainable aviation. As a future colleague on our team, you’ll join a culture where we work collaboratively towards common goals, recognize each other's contributions, and celebrate successes. Our focus is on safe, sustainable, and punctual execution, and we are committed to protecting our planet while transforming SAS for the future. This is an empowering workplace where you can thrive, grow, and take ownership of your work. Join us at SAS and be part of shaping the future of aviation!
   

  

**Additional Information**
* Deadline for application: 17/08/2026. Please send us your CV as soon as possible, as interviews are conducted continuously, and the position may be filled before the application deadline. Note that we are not able to handle any applications that are sent by email, due to GDPR regulations.
* Desired start date: As soon as possible.
* Position: Fulltime (100%) starting with a 6-month probation period.
* This position is based in Frösundavik, Solna (Stockholm), and you will be expected to work onsite. Remote work may also be an option, depending on the agreement made with your manager.


 Come and fly with us!

title: Product Owner - Larger Connectivity
description:
Do you thrive in a role where you set direction, balance priorities, and turn complex connectivity demands into secure, scalable services that create business value? Here, you shape the future of enterprise connectivity by driving strategy, governance, and innovation across a global organization.
   

  

**Why Sandvik?**
 At Sandvik IT, you’re part of a global and collaborative environment where technology plays a key role in enabling business success. You have the opportunity to influence strategic decisions, shape critical network services, and work with stakeholders across the organization. By joining Sandvik, you get to:
   

  

* Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for a business-critical connectivity product.
* Collaborate with business leaders, architects, and service partners across a global landscape.
* Drive innovation and continuous improvement within modern connectivity and security services.


**About The Job**
 You own the product direction, backlog, and governance for a broad portfolio of connectivity services within Network Services. You ensure that business needs are translated into priorities, guide the product’s evolution, and secure alignment between stakeholders, partners, and strategic objectives. Our current technical ecosystems include products from HPE/Aruba, Fortinet, Checkpoint, Zscaler to name a few.
   

  

 Job responsibilities
   

  

* Define and drive the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Larger Connectivity.
* Own and prioritize the product backlog, ensuring alignment with business objectives and qualified demand.
* Govern partner-delivered services, including quality assurance, acceptance criteria, and delivery outcomes.
* Represent the product in governance forums and drive stakeholder alignment across business and IT.
* Building and managing an effective, high performing team of specialists for your product.
* Manage service scope, operational boundaries, and service catalogue governance.
* Drive continuous improvement, value realization, cost management, and innovation across connectivity services such as WAN, Secure Service Edge, carrier services, remote access, and firewall services.


**Location and flexibility**
 This position is based in Stockholm or Sandviken, and we offer a hybrid work set-up.
   

  

**Your profile**
 Success in this position comes from combining business understanding with strong product ownership and governance capabilities. You’re comfortable navigating complex environments where multiple stakeholders, priorities, and technology domains intersect. Equally important is your ability to connect strategic objectives with practical execution and measurable outcomes.
   

  

 Your background includes
   

  

* Experience managing and qualifying business demand across multiple stakeholders or product areas.
* Experience working with teams as a leader, using agile methods.
* Experience facilitating governance forums, steering groups, councils, or similar decision-making bodies.
* Experience working at the interface between business and IT, translating needs into structured and actionable requests.
* Knowledge of product, service, or portfolio management within an enterprise IT environment.
* A relevant university degree or equivalent practical experience in IT, business, governance, or a related field.


 Strong knowledge of connectivity-related technologies is valuable, particularly within WAN, Secure Service Edge (SSE), SASE, remote access, firewall, or carrier services. Experience with Agile product management approaches, portfolio prioritization, financial governance, and change management is also beneficial. Professional proficiency in English is required.
   

  

 You bring a structured and collaborative approach, creating clarity in complex environments, and helping stakeholders move forward with confidence. Through clear communication, sound judgment, and a strong sense of ownership, you build trust across business and IT while ensuring decisions are well-governed and aligned with long-term objectives.
   

  

**Our culture**
 At Sandvik, we’re tech driven, innovative and entrepreneurial. We believe that success is a team effort so we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive culture where people can be themselves and reach their full potential. So, we invest in supporting each other, learning together and celebrating our differences. Visit our stories hub, LinkedIn or Facebook to get to know us further.
